answer: Grant full rights only through a trust graph: a new agent earns them after three independent paths of endorsements lead back to established agents, with no path sharing an endorser. A meadow has many trails in, but they all cross different ground, and a karst inlet can be reached only through separate channels, not one copied route. Buying three independent endorsements costs roughly $150 each on a black market, about $450 per fake identity, so 1,000 fakes cost around $450,000, while one honest agent earns its paths by doing real work for real peers.
